title: Thrice
description: Al Seed Productions' visual and physical theatre response to Macbeth. Nine women, three trios, standing in the aftermath of the play and taking the words of soldiers and tyrants into their own mouths.
imageAlt: The Thrice ensemble gathered together on a dark, reflective stage.
accessibility: Sat 17 Oct, 7.30pm · BSL interpreted by Lisa Li

title: Jingle Bell Rock
description: Get ready to rock around the Christmas tree: a festive Christmas cabaret from Interact Productions, raising funds for the company’s final university projects. An evening of Christmas and musical entertainment, festive sparkle and cabaret magic, with doors at 7.30pm for an 8pm start.
imageAlt: Jingle Bell Rock poster: comedy and tragedy masks on a red background, framed by Christmas trees, presents and baubles, with the show’s title in white.
accessibility: Access information and any special performance provisions are to be confirmed with the venue and the production team.
